content.short: myEtherWallet provides user-friendly, non-custodial, open-source Ethereum wallets.
content.description: myEtherWallet launched just weeks after Ethereum's introduction and has established itself as one of the leading interfaces for interacting with Ethereum. It enables users to buy and sell crypto, stake, and manage their NFTs directly from the wallet. This combination has made it a familiar choice for users entering the Ethereum ecosystem, offering a straightforward entry point to asset management on the network. By emphasizing direct control over funds and simple access to core Ethereum activities, the project remains a recognizable option for navigating decentralized finance.
content.meta: myEtherWallet provides user-friendly, open-source, non-custodial Ethereum wallets. Discover myEtherWallet and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
